description: This file defines the NodeCapabilityRouter class which manages routing of commands to their respective handlers within a node. It handles invocation requests and provides error handling for unknown commands.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityRouter
classes.description: A class responsible for routing command requests to appropriate handlers based on command identifiers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the router with a dictionary of command-handler pairs.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an invocation request asynchronously, dispatching it to the correct handler or throwing an error if the command is unknown.
